how: Reads a repository as it will be read; to report what its essence still lacks.
why: A gap found before publishing is cheaper than one found by a reader.

how: Draws the idea as an article, and the whole chain on one page.
why: The gaps should show themselves to the eye.

how: The four questions, how to answer each, and the test of a good answer.
why: So the method can be learned by reading, not by having been there.

how: Essence's idea, path and workings are written with Essence alone.
why: A method for saying why and how must be able to say its own; if it cannot, it is wrong.

how: Names the tables every project keeps: idea, milestones, workings, and its work.
why: So the answers can be gathered and compared across projects.

how: Every thing a phone does, against every system, each entry with its source and the day it was checked.
why: So 'as good as Android' is a count, not a feeling.

how: Writes the pristine image with the device's known fixes baked in, and fingerprints its device tree first.
why: Any flash gives the same known phone - found out the hard way.

how: Twenty-two checks on the phone itself - the sound card, the amplifiers, the modem, Wi-Fi, storage - compared with everything that passed before.
why: The phone is the reference: it must not quietly get worse.

how: Plays a tone on each speaker and hears it through a microphone in the lab, measured against the silent room.
why: A driver that loads proves nothing about sound. A machine should hear it.

how: The stereo profile, the corrected amplifier driver and two masked services, written down once and baked into every flash.
why: A fix made by hand is lost at the next flash.

how: Whether the modem is seen and ready for calls, messages and data - not yet whether a call goes through.
why: Seen is not the same as working; this is the first rung only.

how: Each part of the phone with its state, taken from the checks and the records of the work.
why: So what is left to do is a list, not a guess.

how: Each fix prepared as a patch for the project it belongs to, with its maintainers named - sent in its author's name.
why: A fix kept to ourselves helps one phone; sent upstream, every phone of that kind.

how: The amplifier fixes and the Sxmo profile prepared as patches with their maintainers named.
why: So every phone on this chip gets them.

how: After every start of the phone, its checks run by themselves and the results are written down; a regression raises a task on the board.
why: A phone nobody is watching drifts away from working.

how: The checks after every start, by themselves, written down.
